content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

queue.body:
$STZ 131: six-month volume shelf held
$STZ 120: September spike average held
$WMG has to hold 28.2 to keep the setup intact.

queue.headline: $AMSF keeps finding buyers at the same line
queue.body: Buyers defended 25 again. Below that level, the support streak is over.
$ACMR has closed red 4 sessions straight. Below 62, the setup is gone.

queue.headline: $AMCR just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 83% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 119 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Software ripping, +1.1% avg on Wednesday
queue.body: $ZS +7.8% $OKTA +7.5% $MSTR +7.5% $MDB +6.7% $DDOG +6.5% $NET +5.3% $CRWD +5.3% $PLTR +4.7% The whole group is bid, not one name.
$DDOG congressional buy surfaced 21 days late. A filing, not a call.
Large $BOLD shareholder Tang Kevin made his 26th open-market purchase in 180 days. The ownership filing proves the buy, not the reason.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body: $FE has closed green 3 weeks. A fourth is now in play.
$LOPE clears 156, and the stalled advance starts marking up again.

queue.headline: Growth is firming while inflation stays warm.
queue.body: GDPNow has the economy growing at a 3.5% annual rate this quarter. Median CPI is running at 2.8%.

queue.headline: $IDA is back above 134
queue.body: Hold the line and the base marks up. Lose it and the breakout was noise.
Rep. Jonathan Jackson bought $GH. The disclosure arrived 21 days after the trade.
AudioEye $AEYE authorizes a $15 million buyback. Authorization isn't execution.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

$CHRD needs to hold 152 to keep the setup intact.

queue.headline: Growth's firming. Inflation hasn't followed.
queue.body: GDPNow has the economy growing at 3.5% this quarter, while median CPI is running at 2.8%. The easy disinflation story isn't in these prints.

Below 99.6, the base is gone.

Rep. Laurel Lee bought $NOKBF. The filing surfaced 28 days later, useful context but not a call.
